title: Here’s Where to Watch FIFA World Cup Final 2026: Spain vs. Argentina Live Online for Free
summary: The 23rd edition of the international soccer championship tournament final airs on July 19 — watch the match for free.
contentText:

The 23rd edition of the FIFA World Cup Final features a matchup between Spain and Argentina, the last two teams in the international soccer tournament competing for the highly-coveted FIFA World Cup trophy.

And for 2026, the final match takes place at New York New Jersey Stadium (MetLife Stadium) in East Rutherford, New Jersey, on Sunday (July 19).

Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup Final with DirectV

How to Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Online, At a Glance:

- Date: July 19

- Matchup: Spain vs. Argentina

- Broadcast Channels: FOX

- Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , FOX One

When Does 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Start ?

World Cup Final broadcasts on Sunday (July 19) with kickoff at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT. The international soccer tournament final airs live on FOX. Meanwhile, if you’d like to watch the Spanish-language broadcast , it’s available on Telemundo.

Where to Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Online for Free

Cord-cutters have a few ways to watch World Cup Final online, especially if you want to watch for free. Online streaming platforms, like DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV and others have free trials, so you can watch FOX for free.

Fubo comes with a five-day free trial , so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month. Plus, Fubo gets you access to the FOX One app for the World Cup Final on FOX.

Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which starts at $89.99 per month. For even more content, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

Who Is Performing During 2026 FIFA World Cup Final?

The closing ceremony of the World Cup takes place ahead of the final match between Spain and Argentina with a start time of 1:30 p.m. ET/11:30 a.m. PT. It features performances from a number of popular recording artists, such as Nicole Scherzinger, Laura Pausini and Robbie Williams. The pre-kickoff show also includes special appearances from livestream influencer IShowSpeed, as well as actor Tom Cruise.

Additionally, EGOT winner Jennifer Hudson is set to perform the U.S. national anthem, “The Star-Spangled Banner,” before the match begins.

The halftime show , which is curated by Coldplay’s Chris Martin, features performances from Madonna, Shakira , Justin Bieber and BTS. It’s expected to start around 4 p.m. ET/1 p.m. PT.

In the meantime, the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final: Spain vs. Argentina is available to watch on FOX via DirecTV , on Sunday (July 19).

Additionally, you can watch FOX with a digital TV antenna for free.
